app.tagline: Advertising reach forecasting for marketing and MLOps teams

dashboard.heroDescription: Configure campaign parameters, estimate unique reach, and understand auction behavior with the live prediction service.

statusStrip.title: Service snapshot
statusStrip.hint: Operational and artifact details are on the {{link}} page.

panel.title: Campaign prediction
panel.description: Set the campaign bid, audience size, duration, and target segment to estimate reach and impression probabilities.

form.cardDescription: Set the campaign bid, audience size, duration, and target segment to estimate reach.
form.cpmBenchmark: Competitor benchmark: median CPM {{median}}, max CPM {{max}}.
form.cpmBenchmarkUnavailable: Competitor CPM benchmarks are not available yet.
form.publishersNamesUnavailable: Detailed segment names are not available yet. Choose one or more available targeting groups.
form.forecastHelper: How long the campaign is expected to run, in hours.
form.forecastTooltip: Select the campaign duration used for this reach forecast.
form.audienceHelper: Total audience size used to estimate unique reach.
form.audienceSamplingNote: The system uses a representative audience sample automatically.
form.publishersHelper: Choose the audience or placement group used for campaign targeting.
form.publishersTooltip: Select one or more segments to focus delivery.
form.publishersUnavailableDescription: Segment targeting is not available right now. You can still run a forecast without selecting a segment.
form.modelNotReadyHelper: Prediction will be available after the prediction service is ready.

validation.audience_integer: Audience size must be a whole number.
validation.audience_min: Audience size must be at least 1.
validation.publishers_required: Select at least one target segment.
validation.publishers_invalid: One or more selected segments are not available.

results.summaryDescription: Estimated unique reach based on your audience size and the model output.
results.uniqueReachContext: Based on {{audienceSize}} audience size × {{percent}} chance of at least one impression.
results.lowReachExplanation: This forecast is low because the current CPM is below the typical competitor level.
results.atLeastOneHelper: Chance that a user sees the ad at least once.
results.atLeastTwoHelper: Chance that a user receives two or more impressions. At low CPM, repeated impressions may be unlikely.
results.atLeastThreeHelper: Chance that a user receives three or more impressions. This is usually lower than the first-impression probability.

breakdown.title: What the probabilities mean
breakdown.atLeastOne: At least 1 impression — the chance that a user sees your ad at least once during the forecast window.
breakdown.atLeastTwo: At least 2 impressions — the chance that a user sees your ad two or more times.
breakdown.atLeastThree: At least 3 impressions — the chance that a user sees your ad three or more times.

alerts.formModelNotReady: The prediction model is not ready. Calculation may fail until the prediction service is ready.
alerts.modelNotReadyDescription: The prediction service reports the model is not ready. Results may fail until the service is ready.
alerts.metadataUnavailableDescription: Prediction service data could not be loaded. Form defaults and alerts may be limited.
alerts.publisherEmptyDescription: Segment targeting options are not available. The request can be sent without segment filtering, but placement choices are limited.
alerts.sessionSilenceDescription: Users who already saw the ad in the same session may not see it again until the {{hours}}-hour inactivity window expires.
alerts.sessionSilenceHelp: Users who already saw the ad in the same session may not see it again until the inactivity window expires.
alerts.driftDescription: This campaign setup is different from the model's usual training examples, so the forecast may be less reliable.
alerts.driftHelp: Unusual settings can make reach forecasts less reliable than typical campaigns.
alerts.cpmGuaranteedWinDescription: Your CPM is above the maximum competitor CPM from auction thresholds, which often indicates a likely guaranteed auction win.
alerts.cpmEdgeCaseDescription: Your CPM is approximately equal to the maximum competitor CPM. Auction outcomes may be uncertain (~50% win scenarios).
alerts.cpmLowDescription: Your CPM is below the typical competitor level. Increasing the bid may improve auction performance and expected reach.
alerts.cpmThresholdsUnavailableDescription: Auction thresholds are not available from the prediction service.

unavailable.title: Prediction service unavailable
unavailable.description: Prediction service is unavailable because the model is not ready.

sweep.panelDescription: See how different CPM bids may affect expected reach and impression probability.
sweep.campaignInvalidHint: Complete the campaign setup before running CPM analysis.
sweep.modelNotReadyHelper: CPM sweep will be available when the prediction model is ready.
sweep.modelNotReadyEmptyDescription: Run a CPM sweep after the prediction model becomes available.
sweep.modelNotReadyChartEmpty: Run a CPM sweep after the prediction model becomes available.

controls.stepHelper: The interval between CPM values tested on the chart. For example, an interval of 10 tests CPM 30, 40, 50, and so on.

validation.sweep_max_below_min: Maximum CPM must be greater than or equal to minimum CPM.
validation.sweep_step_invalid: CPM step must be greater than zero.
validation.sweep_too_many_points: This CPM range creates too many scenarios for one chart. Increase the CPM interval or narrow the range to keep the forecast fast and readable. Maximum: {{maxPoints}} scenarios.

chart.title: Sweep results
chart.emptyDescription: Complete the campaign setup and analyze a CPM range to see expected reach and probability changes.

thresholds.unavailableNotice: Competitor CPM thresholds are not available from service data.
thresholds.medianDescription: Typical winning bid level among competitors in training data.
thresholds.maxDescription: Upper competitor bid level; bids above this often win auctions more consistently.

unavailable.title: CPM sweep unavailable
unavailable.description: CPM sweep is unavailable because the prediction model is not ready.

errors.genericDescription: The sweep request could not be completed.

auction.panelDescription: Actionable insights from your selected CPM, competitor thresholds, and sweep results.
auction.noInsights: No auction alerts for the current configuration. Adjust CPM or run a sweep for more context.
auction.guaranteedWinDescription: Your CPM is above the maximum competitor CPM from auction thresholds, which often indicates a likely guaranteed auction win.
auction.edgeCaseDescription: Your CPM is approximately equal to the maximum competitor CPM. Auction outcomes may be uncertain (~50% win scenarios).
auction.lowCompetitivenessDescription: Your CPM is below the typical competitor level. Increasing the bid may improve auction performance and expected reach.
auction.thresholdsLimitedDescription: Competitor CPM statistics are not available from service data. Win-rate guidance is unavailable until auction thresholds are provided.
auction.driftDescription: This campaign setup is different from the model's usual training examples, so the forecast may be less reliable.
auction.sessionBurnoutDescription: Users who already saw the ad in the same session may not see it again until the {{hours}}-hour inactivity window expires.
auction.sessionBurnoutHelp: Users who already saw the ad in the same session may not see it again until the inactivity window expires.
auction.driftHelp: Unusual settings can make reach forecasts less reliable than typical campaigns.

winProbability.title: Auction outlook
winProbability.subtitle: Estimated auction outcome based on your CPM compared with historical competitor bids.
winProbability.help: Estimated auction outcome based on your CPM compared with historical competitor bids.
winProbability.descriptionGuaranteed: Your CPM is above the maximum competitor CPM, which often indicates a likely guaranteed auction win.
winProbability.descriptionEdge: Your CPM is approximately equal to the maximum competitor CPM. Auction outcomes may be uncertain (~50% win scenarios).
winProbability.descriptionLow: Your CPM is below the median competitor CPM. Winning chances may be limited unless the bid is increased.
winProbability.descriptionUnknown: Auction outlook is unavailable because competitor CPM benchmarks are not provided by the prediction service.
winProbability.descriptionNeutral: Your CPM is within the typical competitive range between median and maximum competitor thresholds.

history.title: Prediction history
history.description: Review recent campaign predictions stored by the inference API. Filter, inspect details, and export results for reporting.
history.noFilterResults: No records match the current filters. Adjust filters or clear them to see more results.

empty.title: No prediction history yet
empty.description: No prediction history yet. Run a campaign prediction on the dashboard to create the first record.

details.title: Prediction details
details.reachExplanation: Estimated unique reach from audience size and at-least-one impression probability.

systemAnalytics.recentActivityDescription: Aggregated metrics from stored prediction history.

system.title: System status
system.description: Backend health, model readiness, artifacts, and service metadata for ML and operations teams.
system.operatorHint: Use this page for technical diagnostics. The dashboard focuses on campaign forecasting for marketers.

technicalDetails.title: Technical details
technicalDetails.description: Artifact paths, full metadata tables, and low-level readiness checks.

modelReadiness.notReadyDescription: Reach forecasts and CPM sweep are unavailable until model artifacts are loaded. Configure campaigns now; run predictions when the service is ready.
modelReadiness.loadedButNotReady: The model file may be present, but supporting data artifacts are still missing.
modelReadiness.publisherEmptyDescription: Publisher metadata is not available. The prediction form will be limited until backend artifacts are available.
modelReadiness.readyDescription: All required artifacts are present and the backend reports the model as ready for predictions.

states.errorDescription: We could not reach the backend. Check that the API is running and that VITE_API_BASE_URL is correct.
states.emptyDescription: The backend responded without usable data for this section.
